tools.name: check_coverage

tools.description: Typical price range for a common plumbing problem in Delaware County, PA, from a fixed table (not a quote; the plumber confirms the price), with the disclaimer and how to reach Delco Plumber Now. Returns no number for jobs outside the table.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Delco Plumber Now contact details: the phone number to call or text, email and website.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_info, chat_with_delco_plumber_now · Private data: get_contact_info, request_contact · Public sink: get_contact_info, chat_with_delco_plumber_now, request_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_info, chat_with_delco_plumber_now · Private data: get_contact_info, request_contact · Public sink: get_contact_info, chat_with_delco_plumber_now, request_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
